description: This file contains Alembic database migration scripts for expanding and reverting the 'username' field in the 'ab_user' table within the Superset project. It includes upgrade and downgrade functions to modify the column length from 64 to 128 characters and vice versa.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Expands the 'username' field in 'ab_user' table from 64 to 128 characters, with checks to avoid redundant operations.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the 'username' field in 'ab_user' table from 128 back to 64 characters, with checks to avoid redundant operations.
